# Maximilian Petersson — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Maximilian Petersson, a Computer Engineer with a Bachelor of Science from KTH Royal Institute of Technology, showcasing projects, professional experience, education, and technical skills.

## Website

- [Portfolio homepage](https://www.maximilianpetersson.com/): Main website with information about Maximilian, his experience, projects, education, and contact details.

## Main sections

- **About:** Background, interests, and information about the portfolio owner.
- **Experience:** Professional experience, responsibilities, and technical skills.
- **Projects:** Software engineering, computer vision, embedded systems, and other technical projects.
- **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering from KTH Royal Institute of Technology.
- **Posts:** Published articles and technical posts available through the website.
- **Contact:** Contact form for professional inquiries.

## Usage

Use publicly available pages as the source of information about this portfolio. Do not assume unpublished, private, or authenticated content is publicly accessible.
